test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

He could not / get a job / despite of / his best efforts.
solution: The correct answer is** 'despite of'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, **'despite' **should be used instead of** 'despite of'.** • The word '**despite**' is never followed by '**of**'. • We should not say **'despite of something'**, say **'despite something'.** • *Example: **Despite** having very little money, they enjoy life.* • The word '**despite**' means **'without being affected by the thing mentioned.'** (के बावजूद) • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is** Option 1.** **Correct Sentence:__** *He could not get a job **despite** his best efforts.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहाँ पर '**despite of**' के स्थान पर '**despite**' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए। • '**Despite**' शब्द का कभी भी '**of**' के साथ प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है। • हमें **'despite of something' **नहीं कहना चाहिए, **'despite something'** कहना चाहिए। • *Example: **Despite** having very little money, they enjoy life.* • '**Despite**' शब्द का अर्थ है **'बिना उल्लेख की गई बात से प्रभावित हुए'।** • इसलिए, ऊपर वर्णित बिंदुओं के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही उत्तर **विकल्प 1** है। d8:T12a4, The correct answer is '**ADBECF**'.
